judgments.reason: The paper releases the home-appliance ERP BCI dataset, including the 14-subject Bluetooth speaker experiment (6 functions) that matches this dataset. Authors also match.
judgments.paper_title: A comprehensive dataset for home appliance control using ERP-based BCIs with the application of inter-subject transfer learning

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used in curating the dataset; it does not describe this Bluetooth speaker P300 dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard extension to BIDS, used to format this dataset; it does not describe the Bluetooth speaker P300 dataset itself.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
